title: United Arab Emirates · executive (head of state)
dateText: unscheduled election held on 14 May 2022, after the death of President KHALIFA bin Zayid Al-Nuhayyan
system: president and vice president indirectly elected by the Federal Supreme Council -- composed of the rulers of the 7 emirates -- for a 5-year term (no term limits); prime minister appointed by the president
winner: President MUHAMMAD BIN ZAYID Al Nuhayyan
